sentences.en: Many believe that the story first began in America in 1877, when two friends were arguing over whether a horse ever had all four feet or hooves off the ground when it galloped.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为，这个故事最早始于1877年的美国，当时两位朋友就一匹马在疾驰时是否曾出现四蹄全部离地的情况展开了争论。

sentences.en: To settle the bet, a photographer was asked to photograph a horse galloping and the bet was settled because you could see that all the hooves were off the ground in some of the photos. 031 What was even more interesting was that if the photos were shown in quick succession the horse looked like it was running - in other words 'moving pictures'.
sentences.zh: 为了了结这场赌注，人们请来一位摄影师拍摄一匹正在疾驰的马；赌注因此得以解决，因为照片显示，在某些画面中，马的全部蹄子确实都离开了地面。031 更有趣的是，如果将这些照片快速连续播放，马看起来就像在奔跑——换句话说，就是‘活动画面’。

sentences.en: The person who became interested in taking the moving pictures to its next step was the famous American inventor Thomas Edison.
sentences.zh: 对将活动画面技术推向下一阶段产生兴趣的人，是著名的美国发明家托马斯·爱迪生。

sentences.en: Actually, he didn't do the work himself but rather asked a young Scotsman in his employ to design a system, which he did.
sentences.zh: 实际上，他本人并未亲自开展这项工作，而是让手下一名年轻的苏格兰人设计一套系统，此人果然完成了任务。

sentences.en: Now this young fellow was clever because the first thing he did was study other systems - primitive as they were - of moving pictures and then put all the existing technologies together to make the first entire motion picture system.
sentences.zh: 这位年轻人非常聪明，他首先做的便是研究当时其他（尽管十分原始的）活动画面系统，然后整合所有现有技术，从而制造出首套完整的电影系统。

sentences.en: He designed a camera, a projection device and the film.
sentences.zh: 他设计了摄影机、放映设备以及胶片。

sentences.en: The system was first shown in New York in 1894 and was really very popular.
sentences.zh: 该系统于1894年首次在纽约展出，大受欢迎。

sentences.en: Apparently people lined up around the block to see the wonderful new invention.
sentences.zh: 据说人们排起长队绕街区而行，只为一睹这项奇妙的新发明。

sentences.en: There were. however, a couple of problems with the system.
sentences.zh: 然而，该系统也存在一些问题。

sentences.en: The camera weighed over 200 kilograms and only one person at a time could see the film.
sentences.zh: 摄影机重达200多公斤，且一次仅能供一人观看影片。

sentences.en: Well now, news of the new system in America travelled fast and a number of rival European systems started to appear once people had heard about it.
sentences.zh: 当时，美国这一新系统的消息迅速传开，欧洲随即涌现出若干竞争性的同类系统，人们在得知消息后纷纷着手研制。

sentences.en: The single problem with all the systems was they couldn't really project the film onto a screen you know, so more than one person could see it.
sentences.zh: 所有这些系统存在的唯一问题是：它们都无法真正将影片投射到银幕上，也就是说，无法让多人同时观看。

sentences.en: Then in 1895; three systems were all developed, more or less at the sai time and independently of each other, I guess the most famous of these was by the Lumière Brothers from France, and they called their system the cinematographe which of course is where the word cinema comes from.
sentences.zh: 随后在1895年，三种系统几乎同时、彼此独立地被研发出来；其中最著名的是法国卢米埃尔兄弟所研制的系统，他们将自己的系统命名为‘电影放映机’（cinématographe），而英文单词‘cinema’（电影院/电影）正是由此而来。

sentences.en: There were also two brothers in Germany who developed a successful system and they called it a bioskop.
sentences.zh: 在德国还有两兄弟开发了一套成功的系统，他们将其称为‘生物斯科普’（bioskop）。

sentences.en: Well now, once the problem of projection had been solved, the next challenge for the inventors was to make the films longer and more interesting.
sentences.zh: 好了，一旦投影问题得到解决，发明家们面临的下一个挑战便是延长影片时长并使其内容更加有趣。

sentences.en: A continuing problem at the time was that the films had a tendency to break when they were being played - a problem 036 which was caused by the tension between the two wheels, or 'reels' as they are called, which www.TopSage.com Tapescripts † SAR hold the film.
sentences.zh: 当时一个持续存在的问题是：影片在播放过程中容易断裂——这一问题由承载胶片的两个轮轴（即所谓的‘片盘’）之间的张力所导致。

sentences.en: Now this problem was solved by two American brothers.
sentences.zh: 这一问题后来由两位美国兄弟成功解决。

sentences.en: They developed the 'Lantham Loop', which was the simple addition of a third reel between the two main reels,C.com and this took all the tension away with the result that the film stopped snapping.
sentences.zh: 他们发明了‘兰姆特环’（Lantham Loop），即在两个主片盘之间简单增加第三个片盘，从而完全消除了张力，使胶片不再断裂。

sentences.en: So now there was a real possibility of having films of more than two or three minutes, and this led to the making of The Great Train Robbery - the very first movie made.
sentences.zh: 于是，制作时长超过两到三分钟的影片成为真正可能，这也促成了史上首部电影《火车大劫案》（The Great Train Robbery）的诞生。

sentences.en: It only 038 ° lasted 11 minutes but was an absolute sensation, and there were cases of people watching the movie and actually fainting when the character fired a gun at the camera!
sentences.zh: 该片仅持续11分钟，却引起轰动；甚至有观众在观看影片中人物朝镜头开枪的场景时当场晕厥！

sentences.en: Almost overnight movies became a craze, and by 1905 people in America were lining up to see movies in 'store theatres', as they were called then.
sentences.zh: 电影几乎一夜之间风靡起来，到1905年，美国人已纷纷排队前往当时被称为‘商店影院’（store theatres）的场所观看电影。

sentences.en: guess the next big step in terms of development of technology was to have people actually talking on the film, and the first step towards this was in 1926 when sound effects were first 039 used on a film.
sentences.zh: 我想，接下来在技术发展方面的重要一步，便是让影片中的人物真正开口说话；而迈向这一步的首个尝试发生在1926年，当时电影首次使用了音效。

sentences.en: It wasn't until the following year however that the first "talkic', as they were called then, was made.
sentences.zh: 然而，直到次年才诞生了首部所谓‘有声片’（talkie）。

sentences.en: This film featured actors speaking only during parts of the film and was called The Juzz Singer, and it wasn't until 1928 that the first all-talking film was produced, and this was called The Lights of New York.
sentences.zh: 这部影片中演员仅在部分段落开口说话，名为《爵士歌手》（The Jazz Singer）；而直到1928年，首部全对白影片才问世，片名为《纽约之光》（The Lights of New York）。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the sound on this early film was not very good and believe they put subtitles on the film - that is. they printed the dialogue along the bottom of the film to compensate for this poor sound quality.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，这部早期有声影片的音质非常差，因此制片方为影片添加了字幕——即把对白文字印在画面底部，以弥补糟糕的音效。

sentences.en: Now, with the addition of sound, moving pictures became far more difficult to make ...
sentences.zh: 随着声音的加入，活动影像的制作变得困难得多……
